author_guideline_snapshot.source: Wiley Global Ecology and Biogeography Author Guidelines snapshot retained from 2026-09-27 repository audit

figures.visual_audit: Figure 1 three-panel concentration redesign, Figure 2 occurrence panel, Figure 3 regional heterogeneity wording and Supplementary Figure S1 primary-label wording manually audited.

complete_now: Current v0.2 scientific analyses and claim boundaries.
Three main figures plus one supplementary figure with current v0.2 renderer.
Separate double-anonymous title-page template and cover letter.
Reproducible blinded manuscript/DOCX builder and anonymous review-bundle builder.
Unit-preserving host-contribution concentration receipt at species and genus levels.
Diet-breadth bootstrap precision and strict equivalence diagnostic receipt.
Current v0.2 claim map and post-hoc inference boundaries.
remaining_before_submission: Choose and add the software license.
Insert final author list, affiliations, corresponding-author details, emails and ORCIDs in the separate v0.2 title page.
Complete CRediT contributions, acknowledgements, funding and conflict-of-interest statements.
Create the final release candidate and reserve the public archive DOI.
Insert the real public DOI into CITATION.cff, the identifying title page and final public Data and Code Availability statement.
Upload the de-identified reviewer bundle to a non-identifying reviewer-access host and insert its URL into the blinded manuscript.
Rebuild and proofread the final blinded DOCX after URL insertion.
Require paper CI, current v0.2 figure rendering, blinded DOCX build and anonymous-bundle build to be green on the exact release commit.
Require scripts/release_preflight.py to report READY before tagging v1.0.0-butterfly.
